primitives.label: Select
primitives.learnerAction: The learner selects one or more selectable entities.
primitives.notes: Items are reusable when configured; an inline layout lets one item fill several gaps. Regions are normalized rectangles on one referenced image; cells are the cells of a grid.

options.description: How many selections the learner makes.
Fewest selections before the answer can be checked.
Most selections allowed at once; absent means all items.
Whether one item may fill more than one target.
A list or grid of choices, inline gaps in text, or an overlay on an image (regions).
How big the pictures on the answers are; course follows the Course.
Round pictures, or squares the pictures fill; course follows the Course.
How many picture answers stand in a row; course follows the Course.

rules.description: A single selection needs no minimum other than 1.
A single selection needs no maximum other than 1.
minimumSelections must not exceed maximumSelections.
Listed items are shown in a list, a grid or inline.
Text spans are selected inside inline text.
Regions are selected on an image overlay.
Cells are selected in a grid.
Reusing an item only means something when items fill inline gaps.
Only listed items can be reused.
exactItem grades one selection.
Set, ordered and per-selection grading need several selections.
A set is graded when the learner checks or completes, not on each tap.
Per-selection grading answers each tap at once.

runtimeSupport.description: One choice among listed items, checked at once.
Several choices among listed items, checked on Check.
Items chosen into inline gaps, one item per gap, checked on Check.

primitives.label: Input
primitives.learnerAction: The learner enters textual, symbolic or numeric information.
primitives.notes: An inline layout turns each target into a field. QQL answer expressions are the expression evaluation mode.

options.description: One answer, or one answer per target.

rules.description: Several answers need one field per target.
A grid of fields holds several answers.
Typo tolerance applies to text only.
Numeric grading needs a number.
QQL answer expressions grade text.
A regular expression grades text or code.
Literal texts grade text, dates, formulas and code.

runtimeSupport.description: One typed text answer, in a field or one inline gap.
Several typed text answers, one per inline gap.

primitives.label: Arrange
primitives.learnerAction: The learner orders or places item occurrences into an ordered result.
primitives.notes: Arrange consumes item occurrences: a word used twice needs two blocks. Reuse is never allowed; reusable choices belong to Select or Assign.

options.description: Whether blocks may be left over (distractors).
How placed blocks join into the compared text: with spaces or without (letters building one word).

rules.description: Inline gaps live in inline text.
Grid placement uses a grid.
A sequence runs horizontally, vertically or wrapped.
Gap grading needs inline gaps.
Order grading needs a sequence or a grid.

runtimeSupport.description: Blocks placed into one wrapped sequence.

primitives.label: Match
primitives.learnerAction: The learner establishes relationships between peer items.
primitives.notes: Items carry an explicit side (left or right). Relationships other than one-to-one need reusable items.

rules.description: A memory game turns cards.
Dropdowns sit beside a column of left items.
Tap-to-pair works on columns or cards.
Lines are drawn between columns or freely placed items.
One-to-one relations use every item once.
Relations with a many side reuse items.

runtimeSupport.description: One-to-one pairs chosen from a dropdown per left item.

primitives.label: Assign
primitives.learnerAction: The learner places items into explicit targets, categories, gaps, regions or cells.
primitives.notes: Items are placed into explicit destinations: categories, slots, gaps in text, regions of an image or cells of a grid.

rules.description: Gaps live in inline text.
Regions are drawn over an image.
Cells belong to a grid.
Categories are columns or freely placed groups.
Slots are never an image overlay.
A gap holds one item.
Category membership grades categories.

runtimeSupport.description: Sort items into groups, checked on Check.
Fill slots with items, checked on Check.
Fill the gaps of a text with items, checked on Check.

primitives.label: Speak
primitives.notes: The learner produces speech; a spoken prompt is media, not Speak. No recognition or pronunciation runtime exists yet.

options.description: The language spoken; absent means the Course target language.

rules.description: Grading a transcription needs one.
A free response has no expected text to grade automatically.

primitives.label: Ink
primitives.notes: Handwriting, tracing and character writing; no runtime yet.

rules.description: Stroke order exists only against a template.
Stroke matching needs a traced or character template.
Recognition reads handwriting or characters, not diagrams.

primitives.label: Submit
primitives.learnerAction: The learner supplies an artifact that QQL does not necessarily interpret directly.
primitives.notes: An artifact QQL stores for review. A recording QQL analyses is Speak, not Submit. No runtime yet.

rules.description: Without an evaluation moment nothing is evaluated.
Presence and manual review happen on completion.
A device captures audio, video, images or typed text, not files.

primitives.label: Presentation
primitives.learnerAction: The learner consumes instructional material without an ordinary scored response.
primitives.notes: Flashcards, explanations, examples, vocabulary presentations and other unscored material. Never scored, never evaluated.

runtimeSupport.description: A single page of material with a completion action.
